RideTheCov Wednesday Series

Covington, KY · MainStrasse

Beginner friendly

RideTheCov Wednesday Series is a social group ride in Covington, KY. It meets 2nd and 4th Wednesdays, 6:00 pm, late March through October, starting at MainStrasse Village, Goose Girl Fountain. Expect about 7–10 miles, easy, gentle on hills.

About the RideTheCov Wednesday Series group ride

Short, easy rides through the river cities to get people on bikes. A quick safety check and tire pump before rolling. Group riding basics explained at the start. Helmets suggested.
